enabled.title: Enable Part-of-Speech Highlighting
enabled.description: Highlight Japanese parts of speech with distinct grammar colors in the reader.

highlightStyle.title: Highlight Visual Style
highlightStyle.description: Choose between colored text, subtle colored underlines, or soft background tint.

colorAdjI.title: i-Adjectives (形容詞)
colorAdjI.description: Color for i-adjectives (e.g. 美味しい, 楽しい, 暑い)

colorAdjNa.title: na-Adjectives (形容動詞 / 形状詞)
colorAdjNa.description: Color for na-adjectives (e.g. 便利, 静か, 綺麗, 親切, 有名)

colorVerbGodan.title: u-Verbs / Godan (五段動詞)
colorVerbGodan.description: Color for Godan verbs ending in u, ku, su, mu, etc. (e.g. 行く, 話す, 読む, 走る)

colorVerbIchidan.title: ru-Verbs / Ichidan (一段動詞)
colorVerbIchidan.description: Color for Ichidan verbs ending in iru/eru (e.g. 食べる, 見る, 答える)

colorVerbIrregular.title: Irregular Verbs (サ変・カ変)
colorVerbIrregular.description: Color for irregular verbs (e.g. する, 来る, 勉強する)

colorSuffix.title: Suffixes & Prefixes (接尾辞・接頭辞)
colorSuffix.description: Color for grammatical suffixes and prefixes (e.g. さん, 様, 的, たち, 目, 超, 不)

colorParticleSingle.title: Single-Kana Particles (助詞)
colorParticleSingle.description: Color for single-kana grammatical particles (e.g. は, が, を, に, で, と, も, へ, か, ね, よ, の)

colorParticleMulti.title: Multi-Kana / Compound Particles
colorParticleMulti.description: Color for multi-kana particles (e.g. から, まで, より, など, ほど)

colorAdverb.title: Adverbs (副詞)
colorAdverb.description: Color for adverbs (e.g. 突然, 時々, ゆっくり, たくさん)

colorNoun.title: Nouns (名詞)
colorNoun.description: Color for kanji and kana nouns (e.g. 本, 学校, 先生, 猫, 時間)

maxCacheSizeMb.title: Max POS Cache Size (MB)
maxCacheSizeMb.description: Maximum disk cache size in megabytes for Python NLP chapter POS classifications

usePythonNlp.title: Use Python NLP Pipeline
usePythonNlp.description: Whether to use Python SudachiPy NLP pipeline for chapter POS analysis with offline fallback
